name: envoy headers GetNote
note: Run against Envoy's listener with convert_grpc_status off (conformance/live/envoy/envoy.yaml); a success is as under the other.

name: envoy headers NOT_FOUND: grpc-status headers and no body
note: Envoy maps the code to its HTTP status and forwards grpc-status and grpc-message as headers, with an empty body; the runtime reads the error from the headers.

name: envoy headers INVALID_ARGUMENT: the details are not forwarded
note: The server sends a BadRequest detail; with convert_grpc_status off Envoy forwards only grpc-status and grpc-message, so the error has no details.

name: envoy a path no method matches
note: With reject_unknown_method Envoy answers 404 and a plain-text body itself instead of passing the request on; the runtime infers the code from the status.

wire.responseBody: Could not resolve /nowhere/v1/notes/welcome to a method.

name: envoy replaces a status's reason phrase it does not know
note: The server answers 418 I'm a teapot; Envoy's HTTP/1.1 codec writes its own reason phrase, Unknown for a status it has no name for, and the runtime's message for an error without a body is the reason phrase.
